meta.purpose: Real-NBA play-by-play corpus for the data spine: per-game derived flow/grammar metrics plus corpus distributions. Full play arrays live in pbp-plays/ shards; raw HTML stays out of git (data/nba/raw/, gitignored).
meta.pipeline: npm run nba:fetch -- --season 2025-26 && npm run nba:parse -- --write-reference; metric/definition re-bakes from the committed shards: npm run nba:parse -- --from-shards --write-reference

validation.checks: per game: (1) score column is monotonic and one-sided per event, (2) every scoring event’s delta equals the points its text implies, (3) text-summed points == scoreboard final == scorebox final for both teams. Advisory (counted in clockJumpRows, never fails a game): rows whose clock runs backwards within a period or exceeds the period length — bbref stamps the odd between-period substitution at 12:00.0 of the OLD period.

meta.definitions: see header of tools/parse-nba.mjs and data/nba/flow-reference.json meta.definitions
